I came here to have a good time and enjoy myself. As long as no one does anything stupid, I won't have to get mad and toast them.

Heat is life. Without fire, humans would still be banging rocks in caves!
You wouldn't be wrong; I do burn those that I don't like. However, I have an excellent reason for doing so. Humans are… What's the word for it again? Oh yeah! Greedy and selfish!
